title: Brainwashed Into The Best You (Naked Audio)
description: This file was a labor of love, and is filled with affection for all my good pets who need that extra push onto the right path. Though I feel it can be just as well enjoyed recreationally, as by those pursuing self-improvement, due to the intensity of the brainwashing layers emphasising a blank obedient state. As it draws upon my previous work in earlier files such as "Acceptance" and "Sleepytime Brainwashing", and the not so subtle ways I want to reinforce that controlling influence and encourage you to change yourself for the better. I want to seep into your mind, and leave little strings to stroke and play with after. That I can call upon in the real world, to confirm and reward all your best ideals, your decision-making, and self-worth. So you wish to follow me and my directions when choosing the better choices. Finding when you are woke from trance, that you get up and immediately go do something good — by being a better worker, better sleeper, and a cleaner, nicer, healthier pet. And if what you need is release, because you can then focus even deeper on the task that you should be doing. Well that's being good to yourself too. That only makes sense, huh? Yes, that makes a lot of sense. You're going to do soo good.
author: Mistress Shibby
